description: This file contains functions and imports related to handling mentions in a VSCode extension, including URL fetching, file content extraction, diagnostics, and command processing.

methods.name: getUrlErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates user-friendly error messages based on URL fetch errors.

methods.name: openMention
methods.description: Handles opening or revealing mentions such as files, folders, URLs, or commands.

methods.name: parseMentions
methods.description: Parses text for mentions and commands, fetches related content, and formats the output.

methods.name: getFileOrFolderContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a specified file or folder, handling binary files and ignored files.

methods.name: getWorkspaceProblems
methods.description: Retrieves current workspace diagnostics as a formatted string.

methods.name: getLatestTerminalOutput
methods.description: Captures the current terminal output content.
